title: Oklahoma's Hidden Meteor Crater Is Younger Than Scientists Thought
summary:
Deep under the town of Ames, Oklahoma, there is a giant meteor crater. It stretches for miles underground. Now scientists say it is almost 100 million years younger than they believed.

For years, people thought the crater formed about 467.5 million years ago. That would have made it part of a group of big meteor hits across North America. Some scientists even wondered if Earth once had a ring of space rocks, like Saturn.

A team from The University of Texas at Austin studied tiny crystals called zircons in rock changed by the crash. The crystals showed the meteor hit about 370 million years ago.

Why was the old date wrong? It came from fossil teeth of an eel-like animal. Lead scientist Elizabeth Catlos said the teeth were probably already old when the meteor hit, and the crash mixed them into the rocks.
why_it_matters: Getting the dates right helps scientists understand what happened on Earth long ago.
